newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FCC sees 1997 net up by 245 pct.
newsitem.headline: FCC sees 1997 net up by 245 pct.

text.p: Fortune Cement Corp, has predicted its 1997 net income will jump by 245 percent to 1.25 billion pesos from an estimated 510 million pesos in 1996.

In a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission, Fortune Cement said that total production will increase by 240 percent to 1.8 million tonnes of clinker per year from the existing 750,000 tonnes with the completion of an expansion programme by June 1997.
The company also said is completing the installation of its own 12-megawatt power plant by the end of the month.
Fortune Cement is a member of the SM Group of companies owned by Filipino-Chinese tycoon Henry Sy.
